map.由营收与营业成本求毛利 使用指南: Gross Profit from Revenue and Operating Cost User Guide
map.输入营业收入与营业成本，计算毛利与毛利率，直观反映产品初始盈利空间，适用于销售核: Enter operating revenue and operating cost to compute gross profit and gross margin, directly showing the product's initial profit space, for sales accounting, pricing strategy and operating performance assessment.
map.输入营业收入与营业成本，求毛利。: Enter operating revenue and operating cost to find gross profit.
map.核算单期产品盈利的绝对额，作为费用与税费抵扣前的基数。: Measure the absolute profit of a single-period product as the base before deducting expenses and taxes.
map.对比不同业务板块毛利贡献，优化产品与资源分配。: Compare gross profit contributions across business units to optimize products and resource allocation.
map.制定目标毛利，反推可接受的最高采购/生产成本。: Set a target gross profit and back out the highest acceptable purchase or production cost.
map.：某公司营业收入 1000 万元、营业成本 700 万元，毛利=1000−700: : A company with operating revenue of 10,000,000 CNY and operating cost of 7,000,000 CNY has gross profit = 10,000,000 - 7,000,000 = 3,000,000 CNY, the preliminary profit after deducting direct costs.
map.由 EBIT 与利息费用求保障倍数: Interest coverage ratio from EBIT and interest expense
map.由存货与营业成本求存货天数: Inventory days from inventory and operating cost
map.毛利和营业利润的区别？: What is the difference between gross profit and operating profit?
map.毛利=收入−营业成本；营业利润还需扣除税金及附加、销售/管理/研发费用与资产减值: Gross profit = revenue - operating cost; operating profit further deducts taxes and surcharges, selling/administrative/R&D expenses and asset impairment, and is closer to the final profit of day-to-day operations.
map.如何提高毛利？: How can gross profit be improved?
map.要么提升售价（品牌/差异化），要么降低营业成本（供应链优化、规模采购、工艺改进）: Either raise the selling price (brand/differentiation) or lower operating cost (supply chain optimization, bulk purchasing, process improvement), while watching for price cuts for volume eroding gross margin.
